event: 2025 ILCA U 21 Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: Panel of the International Jury was composed under RRS N1.4(b).
facts: Small choppy waves and 6 knots of wind.
GBR 224336 on beat to windward on starboard tack, overlapped with an unidentified boat to leeward.
GRE 207511 on port tack on converging course with unidentfied boat.
GRE 207511 at the distance 2m to unidentified boat bore away and sailed 1m astern of it.
Immediately after passing astern of unidentified boat a contact occured between bow of GRE 207511 and port side of the hull of GBR 224336 about 30 cm from the stern.
Both boats continued racing and finished the race without taking any penalty turns.
conclusions: GRE 207511 on port tack failed to keep clear of GBR 224336 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
GRE 207511 did not avoid contact with GBR 224336, even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for GBR 224336, the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with GRE 207511, when it became clear that GRE 207511 was not keeping clear. Y did not break RRS 14(a).
